UseCase.Question: Which five collections have the greatest current restoration workload?
UseCase.Metric: Number of artifacts in each collection whose RestorationHistory/@under_restoration attribute is true.
UseCase.TieBreakRule: Total number of artifacts in the collection descending, then collection ID ascending.

Collection.title: Archaeological Objects
Collection.Description: Objects with ancient or archaeological contexts represented in the source catalog.
Collection.WorkloadDefinition: An artifact contributes once to this collection's workload when it belongs to the collection and has under_restoration='true'. Because collection membership is many-to-many, one artifact may contribute to several collections.
